entries.german: Erasmus von Rosenberg reversiert gegenüber Pfalzgraf Friedrich I. als Vormund seines minderjährigen Vetters Pfalzgraf Philipp über das Viertel an Burg und Vorhof zu Rosenberg, das Eberhard der Ältere von Rosenberg zuvor von Pfalz als Mannlehen getragen hat.
entries.english: Erasmus von Rosenberg issues a Revers to Count Palatine Friedrich I, acting as guardian for his underage cousin Count Palatine Philipp, concerning the quarter of the castle and outer bailey at Rosenberg that Eberhard von Rosenberg der Ältere had previously held from the Palatinate as a Mannlehen.

facts.content: issued a Revers concerning the quarter of Rosenberg Castle and its outer bailey.
had previously held the quarter of Rosenberg Castle and its outer bailey from the Palatinate as a Mannlehen.
